Summary:
`_rust_cxxbridge()` runs `cargo tree -i cxx` to find the cxx version to generate bridges with, and reports any failure as "does not depend on cxx". `cargo tree` also fails when cargo can't fetch a git dependency, so an EdenFS Mac GitHub run that couldn't clone a crosvm submodule stopped with a message that pointed the wrong way, after cargo's real error:
```
error: failed to load source for dependency `audio_streams`
...
  SecureTransport error: connection closed via error; class=Net (12)
CMake Error at build/fbcode_builder/CMake/RustStaticLibrary.cmake:544 (message):
  The crate in /Users/runner/work/sapling/sapling/eden/fs/rust/backtrace_ffi
  does not depend on cxx.
```
https://github.com/meta/sapling/actions/runs/41154980465

This keeps that message for cargo's "did not match any packages" error and otherwise reports cargo's error output.
